title: Mara River Crossing Probability Factors
content: Crossing probability depends on: 1. Herd presence: Herds must be in the crossing zone (Jul-Oct). 2. Water levels: Too high or too low discourages crossing. 3. Crocodile positioning: Affects herd behavior at water's edge. 4. Weather: Rain can delay or trigger crossings. 5. Lead animal decision: Ultimately unpredictable. Observations: 4-5 nights in crossing zone: approximately 70% chance of seeing at least one crossing. 2-3 nights: approximately 40% chance. 1 night: approximately 15% chance. Crossings can happen multiple times per day or not at all for several days. Film crews budget weeks of waiting.
